title: A retell is shorter, in new words
statement: Count a retell or summary only if it is shorter than the source and uses at least one word the source doesn't; a copied sentence fails, however apt.
detail: The grade-3 rulebook's conversation-scoring heuristics accept a gist or retell only when it is shorter than the source and uses at least one word the source text does not. A copied sentence fails however apt, and the frame for a story's arc is Somebody-Wanted-But-So-Then.

evidence.quote: Gist/retell: shorter than the source AND uses ≥1 word the author did not; a copied sentence fails however apt; Somebody-Wanted-But-So-Then as the arc frame.
